Content: ALL female Bachelorettes are now animated:

[list]
[*]Abigail — 10 animated expressions
[*]Emily — 8 animated expressions
[*]Haley — 14 animated expressions
[*]Leah — 9 animated expressions
[*]Maru — 10 animated expressions
[*]Penny — 13 animated expressions

[color=#00ff00]
Installation:[/color]

[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] and [b]Dialogue Display Framework Continued[/b] if you haven't already.
[*]Download the ZIP and extract it — you'll get [b]two folders[/b]:[list]
[*][code]AnimatedPortraitFramework[/code]
 (the framework)[*][code][APF] Bachelorettes Animated[/code] (the content pack)
[/list]

[*]Move [b]both folders[/b] into your [code]Stardew Valley/Mods/[/code] directory.
[*]Launch the game via SMAPI. Done!
[/list]

Delete both folders from [url=vscode-file://vscode-app/c:/Users/schul/AppData/Local/Programs/Microsoft%20VS%20Code/0870c2a0c7/resources/app/out/vs/code/electron-browser/workbench/workbench.html]Mods[/url].
